changelog:
• Updated the GeckoView browser engine to 156.0.20260909172920
• Translate pages: Firefox's on-device translator, wired up. "Translate page" in the browser menu, or the offer card that appears on a page in another language, opens a From/To picker; "Show original" restores the page. Nothing you read leaves the phone; language files download once from Mozilla per language. Settings → Translations manages the feature, the offer, always/never-translate languages, downloaded language files and never-translate sites
• Save snapshot: pages whose content lives in an embedded frame, web components or lazily loaded sections are now archived in full, and a saved page no longer redirects the viewer to the network
• Captured media: an HLS video no longer appears once per quality or once per re-fetched playlist; redirects and seek-bar thumbnail tracks are no longer captured as files or subtitles; a player embed that names its clip several ways yields one entry
• Substack: podcast episodes and article voiceovers are captured with title, author, cover and duration while browsing, instead of untitled after pressing play
• Security: "Disable WebAssembly" is a plain switch again; the per-site allowlist was removed
